published_baseline: Founder-approved production-facing Geomacro website baseline. Legacy evaluation-network pages are retired from public navigation and redirect to API & Agents; buyer-facing documentation no longer presents evaluation-network, early-stage, pre-revenue or pre-launch language; Arc/onchain is presented as an isolated runtime-authoritative technical architecture; public Risk Indices use a same-origin read path with last-verified browser recovery and an explicit fail-closed error state instead of infinite loading; the public roadmap is framed around live product, controlled commercial delivery and production expansion; stale hashed client assets continue to self-heal after publish. Live payment/execution truth remains determined by runtime health and payment contracts rather than static marketing copy.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
